card.name: Words just before 'risk' in GI bleeding warnings
card.fires_on: The small word right before 'risk', such as 'the' after 'increase' or 'greater' after 'at', in NSAID warnings about GI bleeding. Also fires once on a digit inside a page range in a citation.

modes.label: Before 'risk'
modes.description: A linking word or adjective that comes just before the word risk in GI bleed warnings.
modes.example: Elderly patients and patients with a prior history of peptic ulcer disease and/or GI bleeding are at<< greater>> risk for serious GI events ( 5

modes.label: Citation page digits
modes.description: A digit inside a page range in a reference entry.
modes.example: in WHO Technical Report Series. 2003, WHO: Geneva. P. 95-1<<0>>4. Link - Boyle, P

card.writes: It does not clearly push any one kind of next word; it only weakly suppresses measurement words like parameters and indicators.
card.plain: It lights up on the small word just ahead of 'risk' in NSAID stomach-bleeding warnings.
